title: Phase 0.1: establish the production-component MCP acceptance harness
acceptance: a standalone black-box harness targets configurable production-component URLs rather than launching or treating slice1-lab binaries as release artifacts
the harness reuses only appropriate slice1-lab fixtures/helpers and owns its production-facing configuration, lifecycle, reporting, and cleanup
a baseline probe sends a JSON-RPC initialize request to the configured MCP endpoint and records the response deterministically
against the current production component, the baseline test fails because initialize is not standards-compatible; this failure is an intentional, asserted exit condition
the harness has a focused command and README-level invocation guidance suitable for CI and a production-equivalent deployment
